name: Transit Zones
description: This dataset contains polygon features representing transit zones, likely areas designated around transit stations or corridors for planning and development purposes. Each record includes the transit zone identifier (transtzone) along with geometric attributes: the perimeter length (shape_leng) and area (shape_area) of each zone polygon. With only a handful of sampled rows and three columns, the dataset is a compact spatial layer rather than a detailed attribute table. It could be used to map transit zone boundaries, compare zone sizes and shapes, or support land-use and housing analyses that need to relate development activity to transit access. It may also serve as a reference layer when overlaying other geographic data such as parcels, zoning, or population estimates.
